subject: Request: PLG Sandbox Bridge for Shoichi Labs — 90-day + complimentary credits
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PLG Sandbox Bridge for Shoichi Labs — 90-day + complimentary credits

Hi Lauren / Marcus —

Quick context: Shoichi Labs (Kenji Sato) is a Tokyo-based ML startup evaluating Redwood for an embedded inference use case. They started via our PLG sandbox on 2026-07-10 and have hit the standard 30-day/credit cap. Procurement has been slow (internal legal + SOC docs), but the engineering team has built a real integration and we’re seeing promising early token consumption & latency tests. They’re requesting more runway to finish a small UX integration and complete performance benchmarks before committing.

Ask: one-off approval to grant Shoichi Labs a 90-day sandbox extension and $15,000 of complimentary credits (token equivalent) beyond standard PLG limits. No SLA changes, no change to billing terms — this is purely a time + credits bridge to keep the POC moving until procurement signs the MSA.

Why this is strategic:
- APAC anchor: Shoichi is connected to a regional systems integrator we’re targeting; this win could open two mid-market accounts in Q4.
- Product fit: their workload exercises our KV-cache + batching benefits; positive perf data would strengthen our Tokyo region story.
- Low legal risk: they’ve signed our standard NDA and requested standard data handling; SOC 2 evidence is in process.

Supporting artifacts attached: Shoichi_POC_plan_v3.pdf (timeline, success metrics), SOW-draft.docx (for procurement). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/987654321

Request details I recommend we include in the approval note:
- Extension: 90 days (until 2026-11-09)
- Credits: $15,000 one-off credit alloc to be applied to their sandbox billing only
- Rate limits: keep standard PLG tiers, but temporarily raise RPS cap to the ‘starter+’ tier for the cope of the POC (no dedicated capacity)
- Success criteria: (1) integration completed and perf benchmarks uploaded to our drive, (2) procurement issues materially resolved, (3) commitment to a paid pilot/POC by end of extension or formal decline

If we approve this internally, I’ll send a short note to Kenji and copy procurement. Approver request: Marcus / Aditya for exec sign-off (credits).

Thanks —
Elliot

--
Elliot Price
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PLG Sandbox Bridge for Shoichi Labs — 90-day + complimentary credits

Elliot — thanks for the clear ask and plan. I agree the opportunity is strategic for APAC and the engineering signals look promising from the demo.

Marcus / Aditya — looping you in for credit approval. Can we approve the 90-day extension + $15k credits as a one-off? If necessary we can gate release on the success criteria Elliot outlined.

Elliot — please add estimated ARR (conservative) to the deal note and confirm who from Legal we should loop in for the SOW timeline.

Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Sales Manager, EMEA & APAC Accounts
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PLG Sandbox Bridge for Shoichi Labs — 90-day + complimentary credits

Thanks for the context. I’m supportive in principle but want to be explicit on trade-offs and guardrails. Proposing the following (to balance precedent and pipeline velocity):

Option A (conservative, auto-approve by Sales Leadership):
- 60-day extension from approval date
- $10,000 credits max
- Condition: Customer must provide a named procurement contact and target MSA signature date within 30 days

Option B (stretched, requires Revenue Ops/CRO sign-off):
- 90-day extension
- $15,000 credits
- Condition: Commitment to a paid pilot or POC (term sheet or purchase order) by end of extension; Success criteria as Elliot listed

If this is high ROI for Japan market and we want to remove friction, I’m happy to escalate to Aditya for option B. Elliot — quick ask: add a conservative 12-month ARR estimate and a one-line note on partnership potential (SI).

I’ve flagged the HubSpot deal with a note.

Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Legal Team <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PLG Sandbox Bridge for Shoichi Labs — 90-day + complimentary credits

Appreciate the rapid triage. I approve Option B: grant the 90-day sandbox extension and $15,000 of one-off credits to Shoichi Labs under the following conditions (please action immediately):

1) Update HubSpot deal DL-2026-079 with credit allocation line item and expected MSA signature date.
2) Create a short internal memo (email is fine) documenting the approval rationale and point of contact (Elliot) so Finance doesn't autoproc this as a refund.
3) Require the customer to accept the sandbox addendum we’ll send (template attached via Legal) before credits are applied.

Elliot — please send the external note to Kenji after Legal shares the sandbox addendum. Copy Karthik and Legal. Finance will track the credits against the deal.

Congrats team — let’s make sure the success criteria are reasonable and measurable.

- Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
